title: Present Tenses
description: A review of 7th–8th grade, used on every page of the 9th-grade book: the present simple for habits and facts (the -s of he/she/it and its spelling), questions and negatives with do/does, adverbs of frequency and their place, the present continuous (am/is/are + verb-ing) for an action in progress, choosing between the two with the time markers, and stative verbs that stay in the present simple
sources: Proceed with English — 9th Year Basic Education, Student's Book 141906 & Activity Book 141907 (CNP), Module 1 Lesson 1 "Family Relationships" (describing a family, question words), SB p. 7-9
